title: MARS Technical Report
abstract_en: Modern industrial recommender systems use multi-stage cascades--retrieval, pre-ranking, ranking, and re-ranking--to narrow millions of candidates to a personalized list. While each stage deploys sophisticated models, pipeline-level decisions on channel activation, quotas, model selection, and score fusion remain engineer-tuned and user-agnostic within each scenario. This report presents MARS (Multi-stage Agentic Recommendation System), extending personalization from individual-stage predictions to full pipeline orchestration. A near-line agent built on fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B generates per-user configurations--a seven-dimensional action covering pipeline mode, retrieval quotas, model selection, fusion weights, and reranker settings--from a constrained action space. Configurations are validated, cached, and consumed asynchronously; the cascade never waits for LLM inference. Schema checks, fallbacks, and a kill switch ensure serving safety. The policy is trained in three stages: Confidence-aware SFT distills schema-valid generation from a teacher model; Format-Anchored Preference Optimization (FAPO) learns action preferences via ActionMask with posterior weighting; Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) refines the policy through Sandbox replay with a frozen reward model, without exposing exploratory actions to live traffic. Two-week A/B tests across five Taobao scenarios with over ten million daily users show positive gains on all key metrics. The largest reach +5.22% V2P and +7.34% GMV, with positive CTR lifts on both click surfaces. About 20% of requests use a lightweight Minimal mode, and deployment shows 12 ms lower mean serving latency versus production.
abstract_zh: 工业推荐系统通常通过召回、粗排、精排和重排，从数百万候选中筛出个性化列表。但通道启用、配额分配、模型选择和分数融合等流水线决策，仍主要由工程师按场景设定，同一场景内的用户通常共享配置。MARS（Multi-stage Agentic Recommendation System）将个性化从单阶段预测扩展到整条流水线的编排。基于微调后 Qwen3-0.6B 的近线智能体在受约束的动作空间中为每位用户生成七维配置，涵盖流水线模式、召回配额、模型选择、融合权重和重排设置。配置经校验后缓存，由在线服务异步读取，无需等待 LLM 推理；系统还提供回退机制和紧急停用开关。策略训练分三步：Confidence-aware SFT 从教师模型蒸馏符合配置格式的生成能力；Format-Anchored Preference Optimization（FAPO）结合 ActionMask 和后验加权学习动作偏好；Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）借助冻结的奖励模型在 Sandbox 中回放并优化策略，不将探索动作暴露给真实流量。在日活用户超千万的 Taobao 五个场景中，为期两周的 A/B 测试显示，各项关键指标均有改善，V2P 和 GMV 的最高相对增幅分别为 5.22% 和 7.34%，两个点击入口的 CTR 均有提升。约 20% 的请求采用轻量级 Minimal 模式，平均服务延迟较现有生产系统降低 12 ms。
key_points_zh: MARS 不只为用户个性化打分，还为每位用户选择七维流水线配置，调整召回、模型融合和重排等环节。
近线智能体生成配置，在线服务异步读取缓存，无需等待 LLM 推理；配置校验、回退和紧急停用开关用于保障服务稳定。
训练依次使用 Confidence-aware SFT、FAPO 和 GRPO，分别学习合法格式、动作偏好和奖励优化；探索仅在 Sandbox 回放中进行。
Taobao 五场景两周 A/B 测试中，V2P 和 GMV 最高分别提升 5.22% 和 7.34%；约 20% 的请求使用 Minimal 模式，平均服务延迟降低 12 ms。

llm_assessment.comment: Taobao A/B tests show that personalizing the entire recommendation cascade can improve commerce metrics while reducing serving latency, though the tests lasted only two weeks.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 淘宝为期两周的 A/B 测试表明，按用户配置整条推荐链路可改善电商指标，同时降低服务延迟。
